esim.heroSub: No roaming charges. No SIM swapping. Just scan a QR code and go — plans from a few pounds.
esim.whatIsBody: An eSIM is a digital SIM you install on your phone without a physical card. Buy a local data plan online, scan the QR code, and you're connected — no queues at airport kiosks, no roaming bills.
esim.countryPlaceholder: Where are you travelling? — e.g. Morocco, Thailand, USA
esim.instantActivationNote: Instant activation. Works on all eSIM-compatible iPhones & Android devices.
esim.packageCount: {count, plural, one {# eSIM package} other {# eSIM packages}} for {country} · instant QR code activation
esim.liveUnavailable: Live eSIM plans unavailable for {country} — compare affiliate providers below
esim.plansSummary: {plans} plans from {providers} providers · prices are estimated

compat.iphone: iPhone XS and newer (all models from 2018+). iPhone 14 onwards is eSIM-only in USA.
compat.samsung: Galaxy S20 and newer, Galaxy Z Fold & Flip series, most 2020+ flagships.
compat.pixel: Pixel 3a, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 and newer all support eSIM.
compat.checkBody: Go to Settings > General > About > look for "Available SIM" or "Digital SIM".
